'''''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire''''' was a six-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries by [[Dark Horse Comics]] released monthly between May 1 and October 1, [[1996]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|''Shadows of the Empire'' multimedia project]]. A five-issue sequel series titled ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire: Evolution]]'' was released between February 11 and June 17, [[1998]].

While the events of the comic coincide with the events of [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|the novel]], the comic does not follow much of the exploits of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando]] and the mysterious villainess [[Guri]], who here plays only a minor supportive role; on the other hand it includes a generous amount of what [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] was up to during that time, the rivalry with his fellow [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Wrenga Jixton]]'s mission on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
